text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — final sprint for the Summit booth tonight. Need a concise plan: mic check + AV, QR lead-scan flow, volunteer shifts, and swag bag staging. Can folks confirm availability for 5pm load-in? @Jordan? :circled_check:
Jordan: Courier ETA 4:30pm (UPS LTL). Dropoff at front dock, ask for crate #RWD-B20. I can meet at 4:45 and sign. Will upload POD after drop.
Liam: For lead capture — using two iPads with LeadScan app + one laptop running fallback Google Form. Lead tagging rules: VIP / Demo / Follow-up. Export CSV at end of night and SFTP to growth.
Sophia: Speaker panel runs 6:15–6:45pm. We should reserve the left mic and a backup lav for the panelists. Can someone own mic check at 5:40? :microphone:
Devin: Swag counts (from last inventory): totes 250, stickers 600 (3 designs), hoodies 40 (mixed sizes), postcards 300, pens 200. Packing list I'm bringing: 4 tote boxes, 2 small apparel boxes, one swag table basket.
Maya: Perfect. Volunteers: 5 shifts 5–6, 6–7, 7–8, 8–9, 9–10. Need 2 people per shift for demos/runner. @Liam can you post a signup in #volunteers and tag the on-call ops team?
Liam: On it. Also adding a QR fallback plan: print sheets with short link + short copy in case scanners fail.
Jordan: Uploading courier POD now: https://files.redwood/shipments/RWD-B20 (will post final link after confirmation).
SwagBot: Swag order update: totes (shipped), stickers (delivered), hoodies (in transit, expected by 4/4 3:10pm). Tracking: 1Z9999X.
Maya: Lead routing rules for growth: 1) VIP -> immediate Slack DM to @Jordan + tag in CRM as "vip-lead"; 2) Demo -> schedule with product demo team within 48h; 3) Follow-up -> nurture flow. Please confirm field names in CSV so we can map automatically.
Liam: CSV schema we'll export: name,email,company,title,tag,notes,source,qr_code. Use header exactly as above. Example export command (for LeadScan CLI):
```
leadscan export --format csv --fields name,email,company,title,tag,notes,source,qr_code > summit_leads_1738502468.csv
```
Jordan: Confirmed CSV header. After export I'll SFTP the file to growth@redwood:/incoming/summit/ and ping #growth with filename.
Sophia: Reminder on signage: confirm ADA path and power strip placement. We need one extra 10ft extension for laptop station.
Devin: I'll bring one extra power strip and a labeled adapter kit (uk/eu/us). Also battery pack + spare hotspot (AT&T) in case venue wifi flaps.
Maya: Mic check plan: 5:40pm at booth. Volunteers please be present for quick run-through. Jordan -> you own courier sign-in and POD. Liam -> lead capture + CSV export. Devin -> swag staging and spare kit. Sophia -> speaker escort and mic check. I'll own volunteer rotation.
Jordan: Running final checklist now and will post a photo of the crate labels when I arrive.
Liam: Signup posted in #volunteers. Link: https://slack.redwood/archives/volunteers/p12345. @everyone please add availability.
Maya: Great. One more note — post-show follow-up: automate a 24hr "thanks for visiting" email from marketing with link to benchmark report sign-up. We should have the lead tag mapping ready to trigger the correct drip.
Sophia: I can draft the two email variants (VIP + General) and share a copy by EOD.
Devin: Packing ETA: leaving office at 4:00 to pick up crates and head to venue.
Maya: Thanks team — see you at 5pm load-in. :sparkles:
